info.name: M05 — Account Intelligence API
info.description:
Complete test suite for the M05 Account Intelligence module.

## Quick Start
1. Import this file into Postman.
2. Set the collection variable `baseUrl` to `http://localhost:3001`.
3. Set the collection variable `accessToken` to the access token copied from your browser to fix 401 Unauthorized errors.
3. For routes guarded by TenantGuard, send the header `x-tenant-id: 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001`  
   **only when** `ALLOW_DEV_HEADER_AUTH=true` is set in your API's .env (it is, in the demo setup).
4. Run **POST /test/seed** first to load the in-memory demo data.
5. Requests are ordered from lowest-dependency to highest.

## Demo data IDs (from m05-data.store.ts)
| Resource | ID |
|---|---|
| Board slug (demo) | `demo` |
| Board slug (commercial) | `commercial` |
| Board ID (demo) | `board-demo-001` |
| HubSpot account (Acme) | `hs-demo-acme` |
| HubSpot account (Globex) | `hs-demo-globex` |
| HubSpot account (Initech) | `hs-demo-initech` |
| HubSpot account (Umbrella) | `hs-demo-umbrella` |
| HubSpot account (Stark) | `hs-demo-stark` |
| Todo (open) | `todo-acme-open` |
| Todo (done) | `todo-acme-done` |

## Expected responses
Each request includes a **Tests** tab script that validates the response shape and HTTP status so you can run the whole collection as a health check.

variable.description: Base URL of the unified API server (default: 3001)
